title: Meta Connect 2026 set for 23–24 September with Ray-Ban Display, Malibu 2 watch expected
summary: Meta's annual Connect conference will run on 23 and 24 September at its Menlo Park headquarters, GrackerAI and SmartWearables noted, with the keynote widely expected to introduce the Ray-Ban Display glasses with a built-in HUD and the Malibu 2 smartwatch that doubles as a gestural controller. Reports describe a USD 799 starting price for the display glasses, an Oakley-branded Vanguard sports model at USD 499 and a refreshed Ray-Ban Gen 3 at USD 379, while Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth has separately acknowledged a privacy push-back over covert filming and outlined a capture-LED fix.

sources.publisher: Florida Statesman — Meta Connect 2025 recap and forward look
